name: freehire
description: freehire — the open-source search engine for job seekers
one_liner: A job search engine that pulls listings straight from company career pages — not recruiter reposts — so the jobs you see are real, current, and not duplicated across ten job boards.
buyer: A niche recruiting agency or regional staffing firm that wants fresh, deduplicated job leads without paying for a big job-board data license.
business_use_cases: A regional staffing agency builds lead lists of companies actively hiring in their specialty by filtering freehire's data by region and seniority.
An indie developer launches a niche vertical job board (e.g. 'freehire for biotech in Boston') using the open dataset and pipeline as the backend.
A recruiter uses the API to flag 'ghost jobs' and avoid wasting outreach time on postings that aren't real.

money_ideas.idea: Launch a narrow vertical job board on top of the open dataset, monetized through featured/paid employer listings.
Sell API access to the deduplicated, structured job data to recruiting agencies as a lead source.

steal_this: Fork the pipeline to build one narrow vertical job board (one industry, one region) with featured-listing ads as the revenue model — the hard scraping/dedup work is already done for you.
